description: Ministry of Justice - Order made to amend the schedule to the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 43/4 of 02.07.1979 by the substitution to the item 'the District Court of Colombo'
categorisation: This gazette content involves the amendment of regulations under the Judicature Act, specifically modifying the jurisdiction of the Colombo District Court and Magistrate's Court regarding various tax and revenue laws. It constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it deals with statutory instruments and modifications to the legal framework governing court jurisdictions, without involving government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
